description.text: The other BW6 expansion, released on 13 July 2012 alongside Freeze Bolt. White Kyurem, one of the cover Pokémon of Pokémon Black 2 and White 2 and a star of the summer film Kyurem vs. the Sword of Justice, appears as a Dragon-type Pokémon-EX whose attack Cold Flare does 150 damage and burns the opponent. Keldeo-EX and Celebi-EX join it. The two packs also brought Meloetta and the first ACE SPEC Trainers. The cards are numbered to 59. In English it became part of Boundaries Crossed in November 2012, together with Freeze Bolt.
